description: This file implements a middleware for handling asynchronous events in the Superset frontend, supporting both polling and WebSocket transport mechanisms, including event processing, listener management, and connection handling.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener function for a specific async event job ID.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a registered listener for a specific job ID.

methods.name: fetchCachedData
methods.description: Fetches cached data from a result URL, handling errors and response parsing.

methods.name: waitForAsyncData
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the async event's data is available or rejects on error.

methods.name: fetchEvents
methods.description: Makes an API call to fetch async events, optionally using the last received event ID.

methods.name: setLastId
methods.description: Updates the last received event ID and stores it in localStorage.

methods.name: processEvents
methods.description: Processes a list of async events, invoking listeners or retrying if listeners are not yet registered.

methods.name: loadEventsFromApi
methods.description: Loads new events from the API, scheduling subsequent loads based on transport method.

methods.name: wsConnect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time event updates, with retry logic and fallback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the middleware, setting up transport, event listeners, and connection based on configuration.
